content.title: LUCK Q2 Deep Dive: Margin Recovery and Mixed Traffic Trends Amid Expansion Push
content.summary: Entertainment venue operator Lucky Strike (NYSE:LUCK) beat Wall Street’s revenue expectations in Q2 CY2025, with sales up 6.1% year on year to $301.2 million.
